name: Thin the warren
ask: The shaman coddles his whelps and the warren grows insolent. Cull three of the youths — quietly — and Gwark will remember it.
thanks: So the surface breeds killers after all. Gwark remembers, as promised.

name: Szxvu's smelting
ask: I can take 8 silver nuggets and make it into a block of usable silver. With that block of silver I could make many great things.... for a price.
thanks: There's much can be done with a couple good block of silver ... could make a great shield!

name: The Commander's lost book
ask: I've lost my book, whats it to you? This book I was borrowing from the archives has up and disappeared. Just a week ago I was reading it on my trek through the mountains east of Verzanan, and now its gone. I wonder if that shifty-eyed loon stole it.
thanks: I knew that shifty-eyed loon stole it! Babbling like he was, he was bound to be a thief. As a token of my appreciation, take this ring. Its half of a set I picked up on an expedition to... well never mind that, just take the ring. I lost the purple one anyway.

name: The jeweler's cutting work
ask: Sure, I can cut gems for ya. Provided ya find me some good ones.
thanks: Here ya go. A real beauty, that one is!

name: The Viscount's onion
ask: All I ask is that you convince Masha to let me have one of those scrumptious onions... I have to sneak in the kitchen at night just to get one! Last time I tried, that infernal dunce, Tar, caught me in the act and ran off to Masha blathering all about it.
thanks: Magnificent! I've been waiting quite a while for this. Here... drink this and see what happens.
